project.name: OffPeak Gym
project.tagline: Hourly boutique gym bay and turf rentals for independent personal trainers
project.summary: OffPeak Gym is a two-sided marketplace connecting boutique fitness studios with empty off-peak floor space to certified freelance trainers seeking hourly professional equipment access. The platform handles scheduling, automated insurance verification, digital liability waivers, and fee-split payment processing.

business.problem: Boutique gyms sit empty during off-peak hours (10 AM to 4 PM) losing potential revenue, while freelance personal trainers struggle to find affordable, professional equipment spaces without giving up 60% of their earnings to big commercial gym chains.
business.why_now: Boutique studios face high fixed commercial lease costs and need supplementary revenue streams, while fitness professionals are increasingly choosing independent freelancing over gym employment.
goals: Launch in 1 metro city with 10 gyms, 50 trainers, and 200 completed bookings in the first 90 days
Validate product-market fit with a 70%+ repeat booking rate by active trainers in month 2
Achieve ₹5,00,000 monthly gross booking volume within 3 months of launch

success_metrics.how_measured: Booking database records with status completed
Trainers with >= 2 bookings in month 2 divided by trainers with >= 1 booking in month 1
Total payments processed via Razorpay ledger

business.business_model: Split take-rate: 10% trainer booking fee added at checkout plus 5% host processing fee deducted from gym payout

stakeholders.decides: Product roadmap, feature prioritization, and launch approval
Host onboarding terms, equipment safety rules, and facility access protocols

competitors.name: Peerspace
competitors.note: General creative and event space rental platform; lacks gym equipment categorization, recurring trainer workflows, and trainer liability insurance validation

competitors.name: Gympeas / Silofit
competitors.note: Private micro-gym pods; expensive capital buildout rather than utilizing existing under-used boutique gym floor space

differentiators: Automated trainer Certificate of Insurance (COI) verification and digital client liability waivers
Zero-friction 60-minute equipment bay booking with automated 10-minute turnover buffers
Curated boutique equipment zones (powerlifting cages, Olympic platforms, turf sprint lanes, boxing rings)

budget.notes: Focused on MVP functionality with 25 automated agent calls

audience.primary_users: Certified independent personal trainers and boutique gym studio owners
audience.notes: Trainers book and check-in on-the-go via smartphones; gym owners manage availability and payouts via front-desk desktop/tablet devices.

personas.name: Marcus Vance
personas.description: Certified independent personal trainer with 12 private clients looking for reliable, professional gym equipment to host private training sessions.
goals: Book specific equipment bays (squat rack, turf) during off-peak midday hours
Ensure clients sign digital liability waivers quickly before training
Retain 90% of client billing without paying 60% gym commission
pain_points: Commercial gyms ban outside trainers or demand huge commission cuts
Informal rental arrangements via WhatsApp are disorganized and lack insurance protection
Arriving at a gym only to find equipment occupied or broken

personas.name: Elena Rostova
personas.description: Owner of an independent boutique strength and conditioning facility with 6 squat racks and a 20-yard turf lane that sit empty between 10 AM and 4 PM.
goals: Monetize idle gym hours to offset high commercial rent
Protect gym equipment and maintain facility reputation with vetted, insured trainers
Receive automated, reliable direct deposit payouts twice a month
pain_points: Empty gym floor during daytime hours burning overhead rent
Fear of uninsured trainers causing injuries or damaging expensive equipment
Admin burden of manually tracking keys, schedules, and cash payments

roles.name: Trainer
can: Browse gym locations and filter by equipment zone
Upload Certificate of Insurance (COI) for verification
Book hourly off-peak slots and pay via credit/debit card
Add client details and send digital liability waiver links
View booking confirmation, access PIN, and session history
cannot: Create gym listings or alter host hourly rates
Book slots without active insurance verification

roles.name: Gym Host
can: List gym facilities, bays, equipment zones, and hourly rates
Set off-peak operating hours and blackout calendar dates
View upcoming trainer bookings and client waiver statuses
Inspect earnings ledger and request payout transfers
Submit incident / overstay reports for disputed sessions
cannot: Modify trainer profiles or access other gyms' financial ledgers

roles.name: Platform Admin
can: Review and approve or reject trainer COI insurance submissions
Inspect all platform bookings, transactions, and commission splits
Arbitrate incident reports and process manual refunds or dispute adjustments
cannot: Initiate bookings on behalf of trainers without authorization

sample_phrases: Monetize your off-peak hours with verified trainers
Book professional gym floor space by the hour
Verified insurance & automated waivers included on every booking

features.name: Bay Discovery & Equipment Filtering
features.description: Search and filter gym spaces by city, equipment zone (power rack, turf, rings), and date/time.

features.name: Hourly Bay Slot Booking & Waiver Checkout
features.description: Select 60-minute time slot, input client waiver details, and complete payment checkout.

features.name: Trainer Insurance (COI) Verification
features.description: Upload trainer Certificate of Insurance (COI) document and display verified status.

features.name: Gym Host Calendar & Payout Ledger
features.description: View studio bookings calendar, calculate 10% trainer / 5% host fees, and track payout balance.

features.name: Admin Approval & Moderation Console
features.description: Admin queue to review, approve, or reject trainer COIs and arbitrate incident reports.

features.name: Turnover Buffer & Incident Flagging
features.description: Automated 10-minute transition buffers between consecutive bookings and host overstay reporting.

endpoints.purpose: List equipment bays with location and category filters
Get bay details and available 60-min off-peak slots
Create booking, record client waiver, and calculate 10% trainer / 5% host fee split
Get trainer active bookings and door access PIN codes
Upload trainer Certificate of Insurance document
Get gym host schedule and net earnings payout ledger
Approve or reject trainer insurance submission

integrations.name: Razorpay Payment Gateway
integrations.purpose: Payment processing, customer UPI/card/netbanking charging, and marketplace split payouts (10% trainer surcharge, 5% host platform fee)
integrations.fallback: Simulated mock payment response when RAZORPAY_KEY_ID or RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET is omitted from .env

integrations.name: Twilio SMS
integrations.purpose: Sends automated SMS confirmation with access PIN code and 1-hour session reminder to trainer
integrations.fallback: Logged to server console / in-app notification center when TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID is omitted from .env

nonfunctional.performance: Route-level code splitting, optimized static assets, response times under 200ms for API endpoints
security: Razorpay Standard Checkout client-side tokenization (zero raw card storage on server)
Strict server-side validation on all API endpoints
Role-based authorization checks on protected routes
Environment variables for secrets with no hardcoded credentials

never: Never store raw credit card numbers or CVVs on application servers
Never display third-party advertisement banners or trackers
Never allow bookings without an approved Certificate of Insurance (COI) or sandbox bypass toggle
Never expose Razorpay Key Secret or Twilio auth tokens to the client-side bundle

risks.risk: Trainer or client damages studio equipment or causes injury during unstaffed off-peak hours
risks.mitigation: Mandatory verified Certificate of Insurance (COI) / Certification (REPs India / ACE) on file before booking and signed digital client liability waivers.

risks.risk: Trainer overstays 60-minute booking slot into peak gym hours
risks.mitigation: Enforced 10-minute transition buffers between slots and a 1-click Report Overstay incident flag for gym hosts.

risks.risk: Third-party live API keys not configured during local development
risks.mitigation: Strict .env loading with automatic graceful sandbox fallback for Razorpay and Twilio.

dependencies.what: Razorpay merchant API Key ID and Key Secret credentials
Twilio SMS sending phone number and API credentials

assumptions.statement: Boutique gym studios will provide physical front-desk or keypad PIN access instructions for approved trainers.
Freelance trainers already hold or can easily obtain verified professional liability insurance policies or recognized certifications (REPs India / ACE).
Standard booking length is 60-minute hourly intervals with a 10-minute automated turnover buffer.

decisions.answer: OffPeak Gym: Hourly gym turf and rack rental for freelance personal trainers and boutique gym owners
Split take-rate: 10% trainer booking fee + 5% host processing fee
Automated liability insurance verification and digital client waivers
Launch in 1 metro city with 10 gyms, 50 trainers, and 200 completed bookings in the first 90 days
Marcus (Trainer on mobile) and Elena (Gym host on desktop/tablet); responsive mobile-first web app
Three roles: Trainer, Gym Host, and Admin
Hardware smart lock IoT integration and native mobile app store builds (v1 is mobile-responsive web)
Live Razorpay and Twilio SMS with strict .env loading and sandbox fallbacks; keyless interactive Pune studio radar map
Realistic seed data with 6-8 boutique gyms and 15-20 equipment bays
Sleek dark mode with electric lime accents, exclusive/boutique tone
Full-stack Node.js (React/Vite frontend + Express backend) with SQLite database
Google OAuth and Email/Password with quick test-role switcher
10-minute transition buffers and host 1-click incident reporting
Standard cap of 25 automated build agent calls
Razorpay payment gateway replacing Stripe as primary gateway

open_questions.question: Should disputed overstay penalties be arbitrated manually by Admin within 24 hours or automatically charged to the trainer card on file?

acceptance: A trainer can search/filter gyms across Pune by equipment zone (e.g., 'Squat Rack', 'Turf Lane', 'Reformer') and immediately see hourly rates in INR (₹) and available off-peak slots.

A trainer can select a 60-minute slot, enter client waiver details, complete checkout via Razorpay modal (or automatic sandbox fallback), and instantly receive a booking confirmation card with access instructions and a 4-digit entry PIN.
A gym host can view their studio booking calendar, inspect trainer reservations, and verify their net earnings in INR with the 10% trainer fee and 5% host platform fee calculated correctly.

An admin can view submitted trainer Certificates of Insurance / Certifications (REPs India / ACE / Professional Liability) in a verification table and approve or reject them with real-time status updates.
The app launches cleanly locally (`npm run dev`), pre-seeds 6–8 boutique gyms across Pune with active slots, and operates smoothly with live or sandbox Razorpay and Twilio keys from `.env`.
All screens follow the dark-mode aesthetic with electric lime accents, responsive on both mobile and desktop (360px to 1280px+), with zero broken links or unstyled elements.
out_of_scope: Native iOS and Android app store binary builds (v1 is mobile-responsive web)
Hardware smart lock IoT direct integrations (access instructions and PINs provided in app)
Client-side payment splitting between personal trainer and client
Gym equipment direct sales or peer-to-peer equipment borrowing
unknowns: Exact commercial insurance policy underwriting requirements for every municipal jurisdiction
